minutes.headline: Planning Board continued the 190 Electric Ave solar stormwater hearing to June 22 pending engineer review and plan changes
minutes.summary: The board endorsed two ANR plans, heard the Borrego Solar stormwater permit application and continued the hearing so the reviewing engineer can respond and fueling and washing areas can be shown on the plan. It reviewed draft stormwater bylaw changes with a consultant, approved minutes, and agreed the land-use director would work with the building commissioner on temporary outdoor dining. Members also objected to a hold on master plan population study spending.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted 3-0 to continue the 190 Electric Avenue solar stormwater permit hearing to June 22 at 6:35 p.m.
The applicant is to revise the plan to show fueling and vehicle washing areas and forward it with the reviewing engineer's response before the continued hearing.
The board endorsed two ANR plans, for 71 Wildwood Road and 46 Arbor Street, each by a 3-0 vote.
The board voted 3-0 to authorize the land-use director to work with the building commissioner on guidelines for safe temporary outdoor dining.
A member said spending on the master plan population study had been halted; the land-use director will ask the town manager again about contracting for it.

why_it_matters: The solar stormwater permit sets what runoff controls are required on the 190 Electric Avenue site, and the open question about fueling and washing areas will be settled at the continued hearing.
The master plan population study feeds the town's long-range planning, and a spending freeze on it delays the data that planning depends on.
Outdoor dining guidelines tied to matching parking reductions affect how local restaurants can expand and how parking is counted.
watch_next: Continued public hearing on the 190 Electric Avenue stormwater permit, June 22 at 6:35 p.m.
The land-use director's follow-up with the town manager on whether the master plan population study can be contracted.
